rule_text: a section qualifies for a family when it holds a hazard term of the family (governed or proxy; a conditional proxy counts only with a co-term of its list in the same section) and an asset term of the lexicon (basis a only); ranked by impact true first (an impact term anywhere in the paper), then the number of qualifying sections, descending, then governed_term before broader_hazard, then doc_id in code-point order; the top `cap` per hazard family; tagged papers with a hazard section but no qualifying section are listed in basis_b_only.json, not candidates

proxy_lexicon.use: literature classification only; never table matching
